method: Single local wall-clock sample per phase. Isolated copy of final crate source; empty target directory at start; one appended comment for source edit. No native backend/runtime rebuild. Warm host caches, no CPU isolation.
c_method: Two /usr/bin/time -p just _build-fern release runs; recipe recompiles all C frontend, support libraries, linenoise and QBE objects every run, excludes runtime. C scope substantially larger than prototype; not a language performance comparison.
